readout_other: EEG beta power; heart rate and SpO2 by pulse oximetry; video-based body movement and breathing rate
direction_notes: No significant difference between sonication and control sessions for EEG beta power, heart rate, movement or breathing rate under focused, unfocused or spotlighting paradigms (all pFDR >= 0.30).
safety_notes: Animals monitored by a veterinarian during and for at least 24 hours after each session; heart rate, breathing and oxygen saturation stayed within clinically safe ranges.

exposures.label: Focused, unfocused (random phase) and spotlighting sonication of bilateral CLT under propofol

timing.protocol_description: Bilateral CLTs sonicated in alternating 3-minute blocks with a 3 s inter-stimulus interval between successive sonications of each CLT, 40 sonications per CLT per block; sonication or no sonication began 15 min into a 1-hour propofol session; one session per week. Paper states 300 ms pulse duration with 50% duty cycle and 50 Hz PRF.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Two 10-year-old male Indian origin rhesus macaques (Macaca mulatta)

flags.reason: Paper states 300 ms pulse duration, but 50% duty cycle at 50 Hz PRF implies a 10 ms pulse; 300 ms may be the length of each sonication. Recorded as stated; burst rule unresolved.
In situ pressure said to be estimated from MR thermometry (intensity 21% of free field) by previously described methods; method label is a judgement.
ISPPA 32.3 and ISPTA 1.6 W/cm2 (focused paradigm) are stated without a domain; spotlighting paradigm had ISPTA 0.4 W/cm2 at each position.
Control sessions had no sonication; unfocused paradigm used randomised element phases at the same energy.
Spotlighting paradigm only in subject B.
Remus system built by the authors' group but no manufacturer named for the transducer.
